name: Cathedral Basilica of Saint Louis
history: Planning began in the 1870s, ground was cleared in 1907, and the first Mass was celebrated on 18 October 1914; the cathedral was consecrated in 1926. It replaced the old cathedral by the Mississippi as the mother church of the Archdiocese of St. Louis and was named a basilica in 1997.
arch: Designed by Thomas P. Barnett of Barnett, Haynes & Barnett: a granite exterior with twin towers and a great green dome, outside plain, inside covered in mosaic.
features: Its mosaics, begun in 1912 and finished in 1988, have 41.5 million glass pieces in over 7,000 colors over 83,000 square feet.
Tiffany Studios made the mosaics of the side chapels and sanctuary walls.

look.d: Under it is one of the largest mosaic collections in the world.
The exterior is restrained; the color waits inside.

fun: The world's first known radio broadcast of a Mass came from here on Christmas 1922.
journal: Plain granite outside, a sky of 41 million glass tiles inside. Took 76 years to finish.

quiz.q: How many glass pieces are in the mosaics?

a: The first known radio broadcast of a Mass
